sources.title: NellWatson/Qwen3.5-0.8B-millos-routing-q4f16_1-MLC · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A LoRA fine-tune of Qwen/Qwen3.5-0.8B (revision 2fc06364), merged and converted to web-llm's q4f16_1 format, for the on-device incident router in MillOS, a grain-mill digital twin that runs in the browser. It is the 0.8B sibling of NellWatson/Qwen3.5-4B-millos-routing-q4f16_1-MLC, trained with the same settings.
